&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'ordenesww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Order List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

		order OrderDoc  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDoc)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (OrderNumPar)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order (ProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True

		order OrderDeliveryDate  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDeliveryDate)  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderQuantity  when &OrderedBy = 13 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderQuantity)  when &OrderedBy = 13 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderPXS  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderPXS)  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderPrice  when &OrderedBy = 15 AND &OrderedDsc = False

					, &TFCustomer_Sel, &TFCustomerName, &TFCustomerName_Sel, &TFConsolidatedName, &TFConsolidatedName_Sel, &TFOrderKey
					, &TFOrderKey_Sel, &TFOrderDate, &TFOrderDate_To, &TFOrderDeliveryDate, &TFOrderDeliveryDate_To, &TFOrderQuantity
					, &TFOrderQuantity_To, &TFOrderPXS, &TFOrderPXS_To, &TFOrderPrice, &TFOrderPrice_To, &TFOrderTotal
					, &TFOrderTotal_To, &TFOrderStatus, &TFOrderStatus_Sel, &TFOrderShipping, &TFOrderShipping_Sel, &TFFTBCustomer
					, &TFFTBCustomer_Sel)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		&GridCount += 1
		&TotOrderQuantity = Mail.OrderQuantity + &TotOrderQuantity
		&TotOrderTotal = OrderTotal + &TotOrderTotal
		
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	If &Session.Get(!"Embarques.OrdenesWWGridState") = !""

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMER"

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMERNAME"

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMERNAME_SEL"

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERKEY"

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERDATE"

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERQUANTITY"
				&TFOrderQuantity.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFOrderQuantity_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERPXS"
				&TFOrderPXS.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFOrderPXS_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERPRICE"
				&TFOrderPrice.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFOrderPrice_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERTOTAL"
				&TFOrderTotal.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFOrderTotal_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERSTATUS"
